Filter?: Usually yes unless phrase/position support is known sufficient
Why: Phrase/proximity needs position evidence; otherwise candidate docs can contain terms separately.
Universal word indexes typically do not prove punctuation/space token relationships.
Can be index-resolvable with proper fast case/diacritic options or exact range/value strategy; otherwise filter.
Some wildcard patterns are index-friendly; arbitrary wildcarding can over-select.

Trigger: NOT around any approximate text criterion
Why: False positives in A become false negatives in NOT A; avoid unsafe negative criteria in candidate selection.

Trigger: Exact structured equality/range via field range index
Why: Range indexes are designed for comparison/equality semantics if type/collation/invalid-values are correct.
False positives may be accepted as recall/relevance tradeoff, but not for exact-match promises.
